mechanism: Code-to-code data augmentation and fine-tuning for RTL generation with trained self-reflection from compiler feedback
evidence_scope: Our approach employs a code-to- code augmentation technique to enhance the quality of open-source RTL code datasets.
evidence_role: we introduce OriGen, a fully open-source framework that incorporates self-reflection capabili- ties and a novel dataset augmentation methodology for generating high-quality, large-scale RTL code.
